title: Innovative nZVI/chlorine system for efficient micropollutants degradation: mechanistic insights and process optimization toward sustainable water treatment applications
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00357A, Paper
Messaouda Hamida, Slimane Merouani
In this work, an alternative oxidation process combining nanoscale zero-valent iron (nZVI) and chlorine is reported for the efficient degradation of a model azo dye (CG-HG) in aqueous solutions.
